title: Adaptive Theme Sync
description: Matches internal pages to your current browser theme and style. Is not official and may have bugs

           }            if (hex.length >= 6) {                return {                    r: parseInt(hex.slice(0, 2), 16),                    g: parseInt(hex.slice(2, 4), 16),                    b: parseInt(hex.slice(4, 6), 16),                    a: 1                };            }            return {                r: 68,                g: 68,                b: 68,                a: 1            };        }        function clamp(v) {            return Math.max(0, Math.min(255, v));        }        function shade(c, amount) {            function adjust(ch) {                return amount >= 0                    ? ch + (255 - ch) * amount                    : ch + ch * amount;            }            return {                r: clamp(adjust(c.r)),                g: clamp(adjust(c.g)),                b: clamp(adjust(c.b)),                a: c.a            };        }        function torgba(c, alpha) {            const a = alpha === undefined ? c.a : alpha;            return (                'rgba(' +                Math.round(c.r) +                ',' +                Math.round(c.g) +                ',' +                Math.round(c.b) +                ',' +                a +                ')'            );        }        const basepage = parsecolor(maincolorr);        const basebtn = parsecolor(colorforbtns);        const basetext = parsecolor(textforbtns);        const accent = parsecolor(colorwhenuse);        function buildraisedsurface(stylekey, basecolor, radius) {            const light = shade(basecolor, 0.35);            const dark = shade(basecolor, -0.35);            if (stylekey === 'gradients') {                return (                    'background: linear-gradient(180deg, ' +                    torgba(light) +                    ', ' +                    torgba(basecolor) +                    ');' +                    'box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 ' +                    torgba(shade(basecolor, 0.5), 0.6) +                    ', inset 0 -1px 0 ' +                    torgba(dark, 0.4) +                    ', 0 1px 2px ' +                    torgba(dark, 0.5) +                    ';' +                    'border: 1px solid ' +                    torgba(dark, 0.6) +                    ';' +                    'border-radius: ' +                    radius +                    ';'                );        const panelcss =            'background: rgba(0,0,0,0.38) !important;' +            'border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.5);' +            'border-radius: 10px;' +            'color: ' +            torgba(basetext) +            ';';        const finalcss =            'html, body { ' +            pagecss +            ' }' +            'button { ' +            buttoncss +            ' }' +            'button:hover { ' +            buttonhovercss +            ' }' +            'input:not([type=color]), select, textarea { ' +            inputcss +            ' }' +            'input:not([type=color]):focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { ' +            inputfocuscss +            ' }' +            '.tabs ul li a { ' +            navitemcss +            ' }' +            '.containyouroptions, .sidebar, .ssurfext, #chromextlist > div { ' +            panelcss +            ' }';
